chatNaming.label: Chat naming model
chatNaming.description: Name chats from the conversation after each reply. Uses this agent and account only, with one extra model request.

type.label: Connection type
type.description: Use an installed agent, a private model on this Mac, or a provider API.

agents.label: Agents
agents.description: Use an AI agent or account connected to this Mac.
agents.providerDescription: Choose the agent Glyph should use. Each agent keeps its own saved setup.

local.label: Local
local.description: Run models privately on this Mac.
local.providerDescription: Choose the local model runtime Glyph should connect to.

api.label: API
api.description: Connect directly with a provider API key.
api.providerDescription: Choose the provider whose API and models Glyph should use.

model.label: Model
model.description: Glyph fetches available models for the selected provider when credentials allow it.
model.needsApiKey: Save an API key to load models for this provider.

reasoning.label: Reasoning level
reasoning.description: Available when the current model exposes effort levels.
reasoning.manualHint: This model did not publish reasoning options; enter effort manually.

baseUrl.label: Base URL
baseUrl.descriptionLlama: Default is http://localhost:8080/v1 for a local llama.cpp server.
baseUrl.descriptionCustom: Only needed for custom OpenAI-compatible providers.

localNetwork.label: Allow local network
localNetwork.descriptionLlama: Enable to use localhost or private-network llama.cpp endpoints.
localNetwork.descriptionCustom: Enable to use http:// endpoints on localhost or private networks (e.g. LM Studio, vLLM).
